title: Bruce A. Carlson
vital_facts: Married Vicki Lynn Martens in June 1970; sealed Salt Lake Temple in 1972; three children
BA U of Minnesota, 1971; U.S.A.F. Fighter Weapons School, 1979; MA from Webster University, 1980. MA Naval War College (Distinguished Graduate)
U.S.A.F. Fighter Pilot; Four tours at Pentagon; Commanded Air Materiel Command; Four Star General
Bishop, High Councilor; Temple Ordinance Worker
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
